facts.text: The hotel is a boutique hotel in the Short North Arts District of downtown Columbus, steps from High Street's restaurants, shops and galleries.
facts.excerpt: Part of the thriving Short North Arts District, our boutique hotel in downtown Columbus is steps from High Street's acclaimed restaurants,...See More shops and galleries.

facts.text: Italian Village, North Market, the Greater Columbus Convention Center, Nationwide Arena and downtown Columbus are all within a mile of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Within a mile of our spa hotel, you'll find Italian Village, North Market, the Greater Columbus Convention Center, Nationwide Arena and downtown Columbus.

facts.text: The hotel has two art programmes, and over 500 pieces of art are on display in the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Hotel features two art programmes (one of which is from the Owner's private collection) and over 500 total pieces are on display in the hotel.

facts.text: Pieces on loan from the private art collection of Ron and Ann Pizzuti are on view throughout the bar and reception areas.
facts.excerpt: The hotel features dramatic pieces on loan from the private art collection of Ron and Ann Pizzuti. These pieces are on view throughout the bar and reception areas

facts.text: The Pizzuti pieces include works by international artists such as KAWS, Rob Wynne, Nari Ward and Fred Wilson.
facts.excerpt: include international artists such as KAWS, Rob Wynne, Nari Ward and Fred Wilson.

facts.text: The Ohio Portfolio art is on view in the guest rooms, and all pieces are available for purchase.
facts.excerpt: The Ohio Portfolio is currently on view in the guestrooms of Le Méridien Columbus, The Joseph hotel and all pieces are available for purchase.

facts.text: The hotel has partnered with the Columbus Museum of Art downtown and the Columbus Museum of Art at The Pizzuti in Short North.
facts.excerpt: Le Meridien Columbus, The Joseph has partnered with the Columbus Museum of Art (Downtown) and the Columbus Museum of Art at The Pizzuti (Short North).

facts.text: The Columbus Museum of Art at The Pizzuti is one block from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The Columbus Museum of Art at The Pizzuti (Short North) is located one block from the hotel.

facts.text: Instead of a traditional spa, the hotel has Spa Suites that offer private spa treatments in a personal setting.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel features unique and luxurious Spa Suites that offer private spa treatments in a personal setting.

facts.text: The spa suites have custom stone and marble decor and rain showers, with adjacent relaxation lounge areas.
facts.excerpt: Our suites feature custom stone and marble décor and rain showers all tucked into a suite-sized room with adjacent relaxation lounge areas.

facts.text: The Liliana Spa Suites offer couples massages, massages and a therapy bath.
facts.excerpt:
Couples Massages

Massages

facts.text: The rooms and executive suites overlook the Short North Arts District.
facts.excerpt: Awaken refreshed in our sophisticated hotel rooms and executive suites, which overlook the iconic Short North Arts District in Columbus, Ohio.

facts.text: The accommodations have mid-century decor.
facts.excerpt: with mid-century décor, luxury amenities and perks including room service.

facts.text: Rooms and suites feature handcrafted decor and floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Unwind in sophisticated rooms or suites featuring handcrafted décor, floor-to-ceiling windows,

facts.text: Each room has a Nespresso machine.
facts.excerpt: Each room is thoughtfully equipped with a Nespresso machine

facts.text: The Guild House is a signature Cameron Mitchell restaurant serving American cuisine with locally sourced ingredients.
facts.excerpt: A signature Cameron Mitchell restaurant, The Guild House, is an artisan eatery featuring American cuisine and locally sourced ingredients.

facts.text: Soul at The Joseph is a cafe by day and a lounge with seasonal craft cocktails by night.
facts.excerpt: By day, Soul is a café with signature lattes and morning favorites; by night, a refined lounge with seasonal craft cocktails and rotating experiences.

facts.text: The hotel hosts Le Petit Chef, an immersive dining experience that brings art, cuisine and entertainment together, with dishes from The Guild House.
facts.excerpt: Watch every course come to life alongside exquisite dishes from The Guild House. Exclusively at The Joseph in Columbus.

facts.text: The hotel offers a complimentary bike rental programme.
facts.excerpt: Explore Columbus by bike with our complimentary bike rental programme.

facts.text: The fitness center has Technogym equipment, Peloton bikes and free weights.
facts.excerpt: Our newly renovated fitness center features Technogym equipment, Peloton bikes, and free weights.

facts.text: Goodale Park is one block from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Located just one block from the hotel, Goodale Park is surrounded by Victorian Village

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 21

facts.text: The hotel does not accept cash; a credit or debit card is required for payment.
facts.excerpt: Cash is not accepted. A valid credit or debit card is required for payment.

facts.text: Pets receive a bed, bowls, mat, welcome kit and clean-up supplies.
facts.excerpt: Pets receive a bed, bowls, mat, welcome kit, and clean-up supplies.

facts.text: Valet parking is off-site.
facts.excerpt: Off-site valet parking is available at Le Méridien Columbus, The Joseph.

facts.text: The hotel says it has been named the number one hotel in Ohio by U.S. News & World Report.
facts.excerpt: our hotel has been named the #1 hotel in Ohio by U.S. News & World Report

facts.text: The Le Meridien Hub has a curated library of books reflecting the local culture.
facts.excerpt: A curated library of books with topics that appeal to the creative guest, and reflect the local culture to also spark conversations.

facts.text: Guests can get complimentary general admission to the partner museums by presenting their hotel key card.
facts.excerpt: Guests can gain complimentary general admission access by presenting their hotel key card.

facts.text: The Joseph Editions, Ohio Portfolio features limited-edition master printed originals by 15 contemporary artists, each with an Ohio connection.
facts.excerpt: The Joseph Editions, Ohio Portfolio features limited edition master printed originals created by 15 contemporary artists, each with an Ohio connection.
